 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
+from app.db import store
 from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_user_exists(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = store.get_by_id(int(raw))
+    return 200, {"exists": user is not None}

from app.api import handlers

def test_handle_user_exists():
    # Test existing user
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"exists": True})
    
    # Test non-existing user
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "99"}) == (200, {"exists": False})
    
    # Test invalid cases
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": None}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_handle_user_exists()
    print("All tests passed!")
EOF
